name: YINSON
recent: Yinson 近期成为市场焦点，由 MISC 牵头、创始 Lim 家族及 EPF 组成的财团提出以每股 RM2.50 将公司私有化，随后财团又上调了收购价。与此同时，EPF 与 PNB 等主要股东在 10 月至 11 月间持续申报股权变动。
notable: MISC 牵头财团提出以每股 RM2.50 将 Yinson 私有化，随后上调收购价。
EPF 与 PNB 在 10 月至 11 月间多次申报股权变动。
公司于 10 月 28 日向多名董事及高管授予 2026 年限制性股票单位（RSU）。
risks: 私有化交易仍在进行中，最终结果存在不确定性。
主要股东 EPF 与 PNB 的股权变动申报频繁，显示持股结构持续变化。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 7 月 31 日季度，营收为 MYR 11.36 亿，环比增长 8.3%，但同比下降 16.7%；净利为 MYR 1.28 亿，环比增长 6.7%，同比增长 26.7%，净利率为 11.3%。

recent_en: Yinson has been in the spotlight as a consortium led by MISC, the founding Lim family and EPF proposed to privatise the company at RM2.50 per share, and later sweetened the offer. Meanwhile, major shareholders including EPF and PNB continued to file changes in their shareholdings between October and November.
notable_en: A MISC-led consortium proposed to privatise Yinson at RM2.50 per share and later raised the offer price.
EPF and PNB filed multiple changes in shareholdings between October and November.
The company granted 2026 restricted share units (RSU) to several directors and senior management on 28 October.
risks_en: The privatisation transaction is still ongoing and its final outcome remains uncertain.
Frequent shareholding change filings by major shareholders EPF and PNB indicate a shifting ownership structure.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 July 2026, revenue was MYR 1.136 billion, up 8.3% QoQ but down 16.7% YoY; net income was MYR 128 million, up 6.7% QoQ and 26.7% YoY, with a net margin of 11.3%.
